_comment: Which narration recording is APPROVED for publication, per piece and language.
Value: the voice slug, matching a folder under tts-out/<key>/<voice>/ and a
name in VOICES in scripts/fish_tts.py. A duet folder is named "a-b".
A value may be an ARRAY of voices when a piece is published with more than
one recording; the reader picks. The FIRST is the default.
scripts/stage-audio.cjs reads this by default and copies exactly these files
into public/audio, which then ships with every deploy. Adding a line here is
what publishes a recording; removing one unpublishes it (the page falls back
to browser speech, which always reads the current text).
An ARTICLE is one file. A COUNTRY REPORT is one file per section, played as a
single timeline — see the sections[] entries in src/data/narrationManifest.json.
